name: Grounded Docs MCP Server
summary: Self-hosted documentation index for coding agents: scrapes official docs from websites, GitHub, npm, PyPI and local files so agents query the exact library version in use.
description: Positions itself as an open-source alternative to Context7, Nia and Ref.Tools. Runs entirely on your machine (Node.js 22+) as a CLI (`npx @arabold/docs-mcp-server@latest scrape|search|fetch-url`) or a long-running server with a web UI at http://localhost:6280 and a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at http://localhost:6280/mcp; Docker images are available. Processes HTML, Markdown, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files, EPUB, Jupyter notebooks, archives and 90+ source-code languages.
